periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation angled downward at approximately 45 degrees toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest terminal point extending well below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve along the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the superior cranial surface.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semicircular curvature at the apex of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible dampness or saturation of the fur texture across the dorsal and limb regions.
